name: VirtuARTE: Virtual Lab on Gender Inequality and Gender-Based Violence from a Critical and Feminist Pedagogical Perspective
summary:
Welcome to VirtuARTE, a virtual lab that uses
art to reflect on social inequality and to
imagine how it can be transformed.

You are two versions of the same story,
"Susanna and the Elders" (Daniel 13):

Tintoretto (1560-1565,
Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna) and Artemisia Gentileschi (1610,
Weissenstein Castle, Pommersfelden)
